 General Hospital Spoilers Video: ‘We’ve Gotta Move Fast’
 By Chris Eades 
 October 28, 2026 
 Comments 
 ABC 
 Tap Here To Add Soap Opera Digest As A Trusted Source 
 Add as a preferred source on Google 
 The General Hospital spoilers video for Wednesday, October 28, previews accusations, confrontations, good news, and more!
 Who Do You Trust?
 While talking to Willow ( Katelyn MacMullen ) about the various crimes she’s committed being exposed in Lulu’s ( Alexa Havins ) article, Britt ( Kelly Thiebaud ) adds, “We know why you did it — for Chase [ Josh Swickard ].” Now that Willow is suing the reporter for libel, is there a danger of Lulu’s story being proven true instead?
 At the Aurora Wellness Center, Lulu’s article is also the subject of the conversation between Chase and Dante ( Dominic Zamprgona ). And once again, Chase is rushing to Willow’s defense. “Would you damn Willow on Sidwell’s [ Carlo Rota ] word?” Chase asks Dante.
 Related 
 How to Watch the 2026 Daytime Emmy Awards 
 The 53rd Annual Daytime Emmy Awards will take place Friday, October 30, at 8 p.m. ET, and soap fans can watch the ceremony live online to see who from General Hospital, The Young and the Restless, The Bold and the Beautiful, Beyond the Gates, and Days of our Lives takes home the gold. The ceremony […] 
 At the Quartermaine mansion, Brook Lynn ( Amanda Setton ) has returned home after her trip the Dominican Republic with Chase to obtain a quickie divorce. When Tracy ( Jane Elliot ) wonders what’s next, Brook Lynn responds, “I’m gonna do what I should’ve done the whole time.”
 With both the PCPD and the WSB considering her a person of interest in Jack’s ( Chris McKenna ) disappearance, Ava ( Maura West ) is calling in a favor — by hiring Alexis ( Nancy Lee Grahn ) to represent her! But it appears the attorney is putting up some kind of protest, because a frustrated Ava complains, “How about we just skip to the part where you do what I want?”
 Serena ( Kelly Kruger ) stops by the Quartermaines’ with some good news for Jason ( Steve Burton ), excitedly promising, “You are about to be a very happy man.” But will Jason think the same thing after she shares the update?
 Related 
 Who Should Win at the 2026 Daytime Emmy Awards? Cast Your Votes! 
 The annual Daytime Emmy Awards ceremony is coming up on Friday, October 30, but as soap fans wait to find out who will take home the golden statuettes at this year’s ceremony, we want to know who you would vote for if you were part of the Blue Ribbon judging panel! The casts and crews […] 
 At the WSB facility where she is being held, Nina ( Cynthia Watros ) ignores her breakfast tray to continue protesting her innocence in Brennan’s disappearance. “Just tell me what I have to do to prove it to you,” she insists.
 Valentin ( James Patrick Stuart ) and Carly ( Laura Wright ) have decided to figure out what really happened to Jack, and he warns her, “We’ve gotta move fast.” Are they already running out of time to uncover the truth?
 Check out this tease for the next episode of GH , and if you haven’t already, check out the promo for the entire week !
